title: Botox injections in Cairo
description: See how Botox for forehead and frown lines is assessed in Cairo, when changes may appear, which side effects to watch for and how to book a consultation.
answer: Botox temporarily reduces movement in selected muscles, which can soften forehead creases, frown lines and crow’s feet in adults. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, the team examines facial movement and agrees a plan for expression lines. Sweating and jaw symptoms require a separate assessment.
preparation: We review your facial movement, medical history and previous injectable treatments.
howPerformed: Botox temporarily relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines, such as frown lines, forehead creases and crow's feet. We assess how your face moves before deciding where to treat and how much to use.
followup: You can usually return to your routine soon after treatment. Small marks, tenderness or bruising may occur around the injection sites. We will explain aftercare, including when to resume exercise and other facial treatments.
suitability: Botox may suit adults looking to soften expression lines. It is not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or with some neuromuscular conditions. Your consultation includes a review of your medical history and medicines.
outlook: Changes usually begin within a few days, with the full effect at around two weeks. Results often last three to five months, depending on the dose, area and your response.

faqs.q: Will I look frozen or unnatural?
faqs.a: We aim to soften lines while keeping movement appropriate to your goals. Dose and placement matter, and responses vary. We will discuss the risk of unwanted weakness or asymmetry before treatment and review your result afterwards.
Each injection takes a few seconds and may feel like a brief pinch. Tell us if you are sensitive to needles so we can discuss comfort options.

faqs.q: How soon before an event should I book?
faqs.a: Allow at least two to three weeks for the effect to develop and any bruising to settle. If it is your first treatment, tell us the event date so we can advise on timing.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: Review the response to the initial plan before booking further sessions.

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: You can usually return to your routine soon after treatment. Small marks, tenderness or bruising may occur around the injection sites. We will explain aftercare, including when to resume exercise and other facial treatments.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
faqs.a: A history of prolonged irritation or dark marks affects planning. Tell the team how your skin healed after previous procedures so the method and timing can be assessed.
Yes. The assessment is individual and takes account of your medical history, goals and the area of concern.
Muscle activity, treatment site and the dose chosen after assessment affect the quote. Ask the branch on WhatsApp about the consultation for your concern.
